oneLiner: Knitting and crochet calculators that give stitch-by-stitch written instructions, not just numbers: increase and decrease evenly, gauge, yarn amounts, sizes and conversions.
audience: Knitters and crocheters, beginner to advanced, who modify patterns or design their own
Mostly on phones, often mid-project with yarn in hand
US and UK terms both matter (UK and US crochet stitch names differ; needle sizes differ)
mustHave: Blanket yarn calculator and blanket size chart
Needle and hook size charts with US, UK/Canadian and metric sizes, based on the Craft Yarn Council's standards (yarnstandards.com)
UK vs US crochet terms reference page.
Every instruction can be copied with one tap and prints cleanly
competitors: Search for these by name: stitchmath, knittingtips' calculators, crochetcalc, crochetyarncalculator, hobbyhygge. Typical gaps are one tool per site, numbers without written instructions, no crochet notation, and pages full of ads. Beat them on depth and on instructions you can follow row by row.
monetization: The owner may add ads or yarn affiliate links later. Never add them yourself.

# DONE (v5, covers v1 to v5)

## What was built (40 pages in `site/`, all in `sitemap.xml`)
v1 (14 pages) is in `.ai/done-v1.md`, v2 (8) in `.ai/done-v2.md`, v3 (6) in `.ai/done-v3.md` and v4 (5 new pages plus the menu and two merges) in `.ai/done-v4.md`. v5 worked through v4's "10 best next pages":

| # | Item | Result | Target keyword |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | C2C crochet blanket | New page `/c2c-crochet-calculator/` | c2c crochet calculator, corner to corner blanket size |
| 2 | Foundation chain | New page `/foundation-chain-calculator/` | how many chains for a crochet blanket, foundation chain calculator |
| 3 | Pi shawl | New page `/pi-shawl-calculator/` (built from the doubling principle, with a flat-circle check) | pi shawl calculator, circular shawl |
| 4 | Short row spacing | New page `/short-row-calculator/` (short rows at both ends: bust darts, back neck, hems) | short row calculator, bust dart short rows |
| 5 | Stitch repeat combiner | New page `/stitch-multiple-calculator/` | stitch multiple calculator, combine pattern repeats |
| 6 | Crochet circle / rug | New page `/crochet-circle-calculator/` | crochet circle calculator, round crochet rug |
| 7 | Knitting time | New page `/knitting-time-calculator/` | how long to knit a blanket |
| 8 | Toe-up sock | Skipped: the short-row heel's centre count was not verifiable | - |
| 9 | Bottom-up raglan | Merged into `/raglan-calculator/` (bottom-up line and section; a separate page would be a doorway) | bottom up raglan |
| 10 | Project yarn cost | Merged into `/yarn-substitution-calculator/` (optional prices; thin on its own) | yarn cost calculator |

Also fixed: ten v4/v5 pages had no card on the home page (the cards had been inserted into the menu markup and wiped). They are restored, and `tests/menu.spec.js` now fails if any sitemap page lacks a home-page card. The crescent shawl, pi shawl and crochet circle results now show "Stitches in all" for the knitting time calculator.

Every calculation is a pure function in `site/js/lib/` with unit tests in `tests/unit/`. Each new page has a browser test, a home card, a menu entry, a sitemap entry and cross-links.

## Test results
`npm test`: check OK (40 pages), 227 unit tests and 192 browser tests (phone and laptop), all passing. Every unit was reviewed by a separate reviewer before pushing. Blockers found and fixed before their push: the short-row closing rows (two rows are needed, not one), impractical shared counts in the stitch multiple calculator, the missing "stitches in all" totals the knitting time page relied on, and the bottom-up raglan sleeve and underarm counts.

## Unsure of
- Pi shawl: the exact Zimmermann schedule was not verified, so the page follows the sourced principle (stitches double when the radius doubles) with an editable cast-on and first section. It never claims to be her pattern.
- Crochet circle and hat: the round-1 count comes from geometry (2π × stitch/round gauge ratio), cross-checked against the usual 6 (sc) and 12 (dc).
- C2C: one block gauge is used for both directions; blocks that aren't square need the height adjusted (the page says so).
- Short rows: only the both-ends layout is covered; one-ended shoulder short rows are not.
- Stitch multiples: counts more than twice the target width are reported as impractical rather than given.
- Knitting time: depends entirely on the visitor's timed sample; finishing time is not included.
- Still open from earlier rounds: gloves with fingers and Japanese sizes (unverified), needle and hook chart gaps, afghan sizes.

## Owner's launch checklist
1. Check that the Netlify site serves `https://yarnsums.netlify.app/` (the address in IDEA.md).
2. Add that address to Search Console as a URL-prefix property (the verification tag is on the home page) and submit `/sitemap.xml`.
3. Buy yarnsums.com once there's budget, then move over with 301 redirects.

## 10 best next pages (by likely demand and weak current results)
1. "Will I have enough yarn?" calculator: weigh what is left and a few rows, compare with the rows still to knit
2. Blanket border calculator: stitches to pick up around all four sides, with mitred corners
3. Crochet oval and basket base calculator (starting chain and rounds for an oval)
4. Shoulder shaping with one-ended short rows (the case the short row page leaves out)
5. Felting and blocking shrinkage calculator from a measured swatch, before and after
6. Crochet hexagon blanket calculator (hexagons per row and column, half hexagons for straight edges)
7. Neckband pick-up calculator (could be merged into the button band page if thin)
8. Toe-up sock calculator (needs a sourced short-row heel)
9. Gloves with fingers (needs a sourced rule for splitting stitches between fingers)
10. Japanese needle and hook sizes (needs a manufacturer's table)
